description: This file contains shell script code that implements tests for the behavior of the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES environment variable within Git's directory resolution logic. It defines test functions, sets environment variables, creates directories and symbolic links, and checks the output of the 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' command under various configurations.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: Defines a test case to check if 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' outputs the expected prefix when GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES is set appropriately.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case to check that 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' fails with the correct error code when GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES is set to a directory that does not satisfy the condition.
